verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented adapters or integration guides for the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI. The available evidence covers adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here: an MCP server for MCP clients (a separate story), raw CDP connection for Playwright/Puppeteer code (a developer building block), and a generic "cloud browser for your own agents" claim that names no framework adapters.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters
